title: Hexcel
summary: US maker of carbon fibre and composite materials for aerospace and launch vehicles.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Hexcel produces carbon fibre, prepregs and composite structures for commercial aerospace, defence and space. Composite fairings, interstages and pressure vessels use its materials, where weight savings justify the cost. Aerospace build rates and defence programmes drive results.

Technology Exposure

  • Carbon fibre and prepregs
  • Composite structures
  • Honeycomb and engineered core

What To Watch

  • Aerospace build rates
  • Defence and space demand
  • Carbon-fibre pricing

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
